# Trust Verdict engine — CWI Product Card (llms.txt)

> Machine-readable product card for Trust Verdict engine by Cumulative Web Inc.
> Truth label: repo-ci (see definitions below). Agent card JSON: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/registry/trust-verdict-engine/agent-card.json

- Name: Trust Verdict engine (slug: trust-verdict-engine)
- Version: 1.0.0 | Lineage: R3 | Stage: packaged

## What it is

Deterministic, evidence-bound trust scoring for AI agents over ERC-8004, Needle Drop, and First Spin signals. Never invents a score: empty evidence yields insufficient-data.

## Intended use

Agents/verifiers; installable via the trust_verdict skill (no_auth).

## Capabilities

- verdicts: scored / insufficient-data / evidence-disputed / unknown-context / invalid-input
- determinism check: run twice on the same input, diff the bytes
- vendored engine v1.0.0, byte-identical across processes

## Honest limitations

Engine v1.0.0 lives on the unmerged cwi-learn branch needs/verdict-engine (do not treat as main); fetch the skill from cwi-mcp-public. Never invents a score by design.

## Try / equip

- Run: SKILL: trust_verdict (~/workspace/skills/trust-verdict/) — input per trust/spec.md section 3; determinism: run twice, diff bytes. Equip for agents: query cwi-mcp-public trust_verdict tool.
- Equip: SKILL: trust_verdict (~/workspace/skills/trust-verdict/) — input per trust/spec.md section 3; determinism: run twice, diff bytes. Equip for agents: query cwi-mcp-public trust_verdict tool.

Skill suite: empty-evidence test passing; engine determinism verified live 2026-10-01 (identical bytes, empty evidence -> insufficient-data, no invented score).
